task.title: Migrate simple actions and typography batch

batch.rollback: Retain current React implementations until canonical-backed facades pass every ADR-009 batch gate.

evidence.finding: The public component forwards HTMLButtonElement and inherits ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>. A vf-button Custom Element is not an HTMLButtonElement, so substituting it behind the same public type would make the ref and native-element contract unsound.
evidence.requiredResolution: Preserve a genuinely compatible ref/native surface or record a narrow ADR-008 migration compatibility exception with evidence and exit criteria. Do not use a type cast as parity evidence.

evidence.finding: The public React component supports an arbitrary polymorphic `as` ElementType and forwards the corresponding DOM props. Replacing that behavior with one fixed Custom Element requires an explicit compatibility mapping rather than silently changing rendered semantic element ownership.
evidence.requiredResolution: Prove a canonical-backed polymorphic mapping or retain a narrow React integration path until the public semantic contract can be preserved.

rules: Do not mark MFD-1409 migrated while a public native ref/type contract is only preserved through an unsound cast.
Do not remove legacy React source in the initial cutover step.
Resolve blockers through shared facade capability or explicit ADR-008 evidence, not component-specific hidden forks.
